source: GET http://127.0.0.1:43173/api/state captured before the new design Runs
visiblePageFacts: The primary page shows a search field, Run list, selected Run detail, Task table, session list and exact artifact refs.
The status and Run list refresh by polling /api/state every two seconds.
The separately selected synthetic product preview opens at /preview in a new tab; the page does not claim that it came from the selected Run.
